title: PolyOCR-Venus: Unified OCR Foundation Models for Text-Centric Visual Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2609.37712v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is evolving from plain-text transcription toward general visual intelligence, requiring models to recognize, localize, and reason over textual information in complex visual environments. However, existing OCR systems often excel at only some tasks and struggle to balance recognition, parsing, and reasoning across scenarios. In this report, we present PolyOCR, a family of unified OCR foundation models of varying scales. PolyOCR combines a shared instruction-following framework with a large-scale data engine that converts heterogeneous visual resources into quality-verified OCR supervision. We introduce Competence-Guided Policy Optimization, which combines verifier-based Group Relative Policy Optimization with on-policy distillation through sample-wise routing based on teacher reliability and the teacher--student competence gap. translated_title: PolyOCR-Venus：面向以文本为中心的视觉智能的统一OCR基础模型
translated_abstract: 光学字符识别（OCR）正在从纯文本转录向通用视觉智能演进，这要求模型能够在复杂的视觉环境中识别、定位并推理文本信息。然而，现有的OCR系统往往仅在部分任务上表现出色，难以在不同场景间平衡识别、解析与推理能力。在本报告中，我们提出了PolyOCR，这是一系列不同规模的统一OCR基础模型。PolyOCR将共享的指令遵循框架与大规模数据引擎相结合，该数据引擎能够将异构的视觉资源转化为经过质量验证的OCR监督数据。我们引入了能力引导的策略优化，该方法将基于验证器的组相对策略优化与在线策略蒸馏相结合，通过基于教师可靠性与师生能力差距的样本级路由机制实现。此外，我们还推出了OCRBench v2.1，这是我们对OCRBench v2的修订版本，通过人工（原文在此处截断）
tldr: PolyOCR是一系列不同规模的统一OCR基础模型，通过共享指令框架、大规模数据引擎以及创新的能力引导策略优化方法，在识别、解析与推理任务间实现平衡，并同时发布了修订版基准OCRBench v2.1。
en_tdlr: PolyOCR is a family of unified OCR foundation models that balances recognition, parsing, and reasoning through a shared instruction framework, a large-scale data engine, and novel Competence-Guided Policy Optimization, alongside the revised OCRBench v2.1 benchmark.
